attestation.notes_en: Microtasks 177 syna_open, 178 syna_release, 242 syna_pal_mem_cpy, 290 syna_tcm_set_report_dispatcher, 291 syna_tcm_set_data_duplicator, 292 syna_tcm_clear_data_duplicator, 294 syna_tcm_set_post_reset_callback, 314 and 319 syna_pal_mem_free, 321 syna_tcm_set_custom_touch_entity_callback, and 322 syna_tcm_set_custom_gesture_callback were executed locally in a clean worktree. For each target, stock Ghidra/P-Code, assembly, KCFI, strict Joern, and an ASan/UBSan harness that includes the production source were verified. The duplicate stock names use explicit identities: microtask 242 is syna_pal_mem_cpy@0011da1c, 314 is syna_pal_mem_free@001284c0, and 319 is syna_pal_mem_free@0012a4ec. All three pairs have NO_VALID_KCFI_PREAMBLE, so no KCFI type ID is claimed. The complete module was built twice with identical SHA-256 values and its KMI parity was checked. No smartphone, loadable module, or hardware was used. The complete driver remains incomplete.
attestation.notes_pt: As microtarefas 177 syna_open, 178 syna_release, 242 syna_pal_mem_cpy, 290 syna_tcm_set_report_dispatcher, 291 syna_tcm_set_data_duplicator, 292 syna_tcm_clear_data_duplicator, 294 syna_tcm_set_post_reset_callback, 314 e 319 syna_pal_mem_free, 321 syna_tcm_set_custom_touch_entity_callback e 322 syna_tcm_set_custom_gesture_callback foram executadas localmente em uma worktree limpa. Para cada alvo, Ghidra/P-Code stock, Assembly, KCFI, Joern estrito e um harness ASAN/UBSAN que inclui a fonte de producao foram verificados. Os nomes stock duplicados usam identidades explicitas: a microtarefa 242 e syna_pal_mem_cpy@0011da1c, a 314 e syna_pal_mem_free@001284c0 e a 319 e syna_pal_mem_free@0012a4ec. Os tres pares tem NO_VALID_KCFI_PREAMBLE, portanto nenhum type ID KCFI e alegado. O modulo completo foi compilado duas vezes com SHA-256 identico e sua paridade KMI foi conferida. Nenhum smartphone, modulo carregavel ou hardware foi usado. O driver completo permanece incompleto.
